all_b_vs_t.title: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia — B-cell vs T-cell
all_b_vs_t.description: Use this tree when the report says ALL or Lymphoblastic Leukemia without specifying B or T lineage.
all_b_vs_t.question: What does the IHC panel show?

result_b_all.label: B-ALL — B Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma
result_b_all.notes: If specific cytogenetic abnormality known (e.g. BCR-ABL), use more specific code: 9812 (BCR-ABL1), 9814 (ETV6-RUNX1), 9815 (hyperdiploidy), 9816 (hypodiploidy).

result_t_all.label: T-ALL — Precursor T-cell Lymphoblastic Leukemia
result_t_all.notes: Also CD7+, CD2+. TdT positivity confirms precursor (not mature T-cell).

result_mature_b.label: Mature B-cell Leukemia (not ALL)
result_mature_b.morphology_name: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma
result_mature_b.notes: Consider Burkitt leukemia (9826) if CD10+, Ki-67 ~100%, MYC translocation.

result_mature_t.label: Mature T-cell Leukemia (not ALL)
result_mature_t.iccc3_subgroup_name: Mature T-cell and NK cell leukemias
result_mature_t.notes: Consider HTLV-1 status. Rare in paediatrics.

result_unknown.label: Lineage Unclassifiable — Leukemia NOS
result_unknown.notes: Insufficient IHC for lineage determination. Use 9800 as last resort.

lymphoma_nos.title: Lymphoma NOS — Hodgkin vs Non-Hodgkin vs Burkitt
lymphoma_nos.description: Use this tree when the report says 'Lymphoma' without specifying type.
lymphoma_nos.question: What does the IHC panel show?

root.question: Are Reed-Sternberg cells present OR is CD30 strongly positive?

node_cd20_pos.question: Is Ki-67 close to 100% AND is MYC translocation present (or starry sky pattern)?

result_hodgkin.label: Hodgkin Lymphoma
result_hodgkin.notes: Use specific subtype code if available: 9663 (nodular sclerosis — most common in adolescents), 9652 (mixed cellularity — more common in younger children / EBV-positive).

result_hodgkin_nlphl.label: Hodgkin Lymphoma, Nodular Lymphocyte Predominance
result_hodgkin_nlphl.notes: NLPHL — popcorn cells. Different biology from classical HL. Code 9659.

result_alcl.label: Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma (ALCL)
result_alcl.morphology_name: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, T cell and Null cell type
result_alcl.notes: Common paediatric T-cell lymphoma. ALK+ve has better prognosis.

result_burkitt.label: Burkitt Lymphoma
result_burkitt.notes: Most common childhood lymphoma in sub-Saharan Africa. Jaw/abdominal involvement. MYC translocation t(8;14). Code 9687.

result_nhl_b.label: B-cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
result_nhl_b.morphology_name: Malignant lymphoma, large B-cell, diffuse, NOS
result_nhl_b.notes: Default to DLBCL (9680) for large B-cell lymphoma. If follicular pattern → follicular lymphoma (9690). If small cells → CLL/SLL (9823 if leukemic).

result_nhl_t.label: T-cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
result_nhl_t.notes: Code 9702 if NOS. Consider ALCL (9714, CD30+, ALK+) or PTCL (9702).

result_lymphoma_nos.label: Lymphoma NOS
result_lymphoma_nos.notes: Last resort — consider repeating IHC panel. Code 9590.

round_cell_tumour.title: Small Round Cell Tumour — Differential Diagnosis
round_cell_tumour.description: Use when pathology shows small round blue cells without clear diagnosis. Common paediatric entities: neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma, RMS, Wilms, lymphoma.
round_cell_tumour.question: What does the IHC panel show?

node_cd99_neg.question: Is Desmin OR MyoD1 OR Myogenin positive?

node_desmin_neg.question: Is WT1 positive (nuclear) AND primary site kidney?

node_wt1_neg.question: Is CD20 or CD3 or CD30 positive?

result_neuroblastoma.label: Neuroblastoma
result_neuroblastoma.notes: Most common in adrenal/abdominal location. NSE+, CD56+. Urine catecholamines elevated. Code 9500.

result_ewing.label: Ewing Sarcoma / PNET
result_ewing.iccc3_subgroup_name: Ewing tumor and Askin tumor of bone
result_ewing.notes: EWSR1 translocation (FISH). If bone primary → Group VIII (9260). If soft tissue → Group IX (9260 different topography). FLI1+. Code 9260.

result_rms.label: Rhabdomyosarcoma
result_rms.notes: Code 8900 (NOS). Embryonal RMS more common in young children; alveolar RMS (8920) in older children/adolescents. PAX-FOXO1 fusion in alveolar type.

result_wilms.label: Nephroblastoma (Wilms Tumour)
result_wilms.notes: Triphasic histology (blastemal/stromal/epithelial). Must have C64.9 topography. Code 8960.

result_lymphoma.label: Lymphoma — see IHC tree
result_lymphoma.notes: See Lymphoma NOS decision tree for further classification.

result_unknown_srct.label: Small Round Cell Tumour, Unclassified
result_unknown_srct.notes: Consider extended panel or molecular testing. Code 8005 as last resort.
